Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Naradiya Dharmasastra Of The Institutes Of Narada. · Jolly, Julius. Tran. · 1876, 173 scanned pages. Published 1876; Julius Jolly died 1932; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit.
